_readme: Display-value -> body wire-word laws for parameters whose display value is NOT a simple scale (map scale==1). word = round_half_up(normalized * 65534). Tapers: linear = (v-min)/(max-min); log = log10(v/min)/log10(max/min); int-raw = the word IS the raw integer value. 'confidence' reflects how firmly each range is established; treat 'unknown'/'documented' as needing your own verification and 'device-verified' as confirmed against hardware anchors (FW 32.02). Use with axefx_sysex_map.json for the param ids and set opcodes.
